about: Nicolet is a city in Centre-du-Québec, on the south shore of the St. Lawrence at Lac Saint-Pierre, opposite Trois-Rivières—not Trois-Rivières itself. A cathedral city with seminary and religious-heritage landmarks, it sits at the Nicolet River mouth among lowland farms. About 9,000 people live in Nicolet.
